native.units: dp for layout; sp for text. Browser previews approximate logical units with CSS pixels.
native.rampProvenance: Synthesized OKLCH documentation swatches; not implemented palette variants.
native.layoutCondition: Temperature study: available height < 600dp or font scale > 1.25 selects whole-content scrolling. Four added scenes: centered body and Experiment / Understand selector capped at 600dp; separate tab scroll positions. Collection Experiment uses its lazy grid/list as scroll owner; other scenes scroll as pages.
native.previewLimit: Illustrative HTML/CSS documentation only. No native runtime or screenshot equivalence.
native.visualGate: Strict raw score 71.03%, below 72%; native adaptations separately reviewed.
native.motionComparison: Two horizontal lanes expose raw animation position with an amber 100% target and space to 150%. Selected mode is lime, other marker is the text color. Playback speed 1x/0.5x/0.25x scales time while retaining Android motion-off. This is an experiment diagnostic, not temperature data.
native.galleryCards: Text-led cards with description, cyan mechanism label and full-width opening action; no chart preview.
native.agendaFallback: Timeline when available content width >= 360dp and font scale <= 1.2; otherwise chronological list, disabled zoom and explanatory text. Event details and 15-minute move actions remain available.
native.fieldsAndChips: Native Material OutlinedTextField and FilterChip retain library shapes, focus, error and selection treatments. Session validation uses supporting text; collection chips wrap with 8dp horizontal gaps.
native.sceneFraming: ExperimentFrame preserves safe-drawing and IME insets. Body padding 20dp, content gap 16dp. LabSurface uses the existing 16dp rounded outlined surface and 20dp padding.

narrative.overview:
Instrument is a measuring surface where changes can be inspected, replayed and understood. Green-black fields hold clear measurements, solid lime and dashed cyan traces, and an amber selection cursor. Material 3 provides native Android interaction and text scaling.

This records the implemented dark-only system, extracted from InstrumentTheme.kt, ExperimentGallery.kt, AtlasApp.kt, ControlPanel.kt, TemperatureChart.kt and the Player, Collection, Form and Agenda experience files under app/src/main/java/dev/devaxes/composeatlas/ui. PRODUCT.md establishes the offline, synthetic-data scope. The approved surface brief selects composition B with C explanations for Temperature study; the gallery extension retains Instrument with a shared native scene frame rather than repeating the chart composition.
keyCharacteristics: Tonal green-black surfaces with restrained outlines.
Series identity carried by color, line pattern and names.
Native controls and readable, scalable text.
Five working experiments in an evolving gallery: Quiet frequency, Temperature study, Object collection, Session builder and Spatial agenda.

rules.name: The Trace Identity Rule
rules.body: Keep Studio solid lime and Gallery dashed cyan wherever these series appear; pair the traces with explicit names.

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: Use Material typography roles and system font scaling; the timestamp alone uses monospace.

rules.name: The Reachable Controls Rule
rules.body: Preserve the scroll fallback when the available height is short or the system font size is enlarged.

rules.name: The Tonal Separation Rule
rules.body: Separate the plot, readout and control surface with tone and fine outlines, without adding decorative shadows.

rules.name: The Honest Measurement Rule
rules.body: A gap stays missing, never zero; replay reveals the existing trace instead of fabricating measurements.

dos: Do use native Material controls with semantic labels and visible state.
Do retain text readouts and Previous point / Next point alongside chart gestures.
Do preserve system insets and scalable text.
Do present only implemented gallery experiments as available.
donts: Don't replace native text or charts with reference-image rasters.
Don't rely on color alone to distinguish the two series.
Don't imply light-theme, dynamic-color or tablet two-pane support exists in this milestone.
